task_definition.description: Browser automation example using Playwright via OpenClaw bridge

compute_logic.code:
import json
import asyncio
import subprocess
import sys

try:
    from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
except ImportError:
    # Playwright package should be auto-installed by Corebrum, but if not:
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', 'playwright'])
    from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

async def main():
    # Install browser binaries if needed (check by trying to launch)
    try:
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
            await browser.close()
    except Exception as e:
        # Browser binaries not installed, install them
        print(f'Installing Chromium browser binaries... (error: {e})', file=sys.stderr)
        subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, '-m', 'playwright', 'install', 'chromium'])
        # Retry after installation
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
            await browser.close()
    
    # Now run the actual browser automation
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        # Launch browser (headless by default)
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        
        # Navigate to a website
        await page.goto('https://corebrum.com')
        
        # Extract page information
        title = await page.title()
        url = page.url
        
        # Get page content
        heading = await page.query_selector('h1')
        heading_text = await heading.inner_text() if heading else None
        
        # Take a screenshot (optional, for debugging)
        # screenshot = await page.screenshot(path='screenshot.png')
        
        await browser.close()
        
        return {
            'message': 'Browser automation successful',
            'title': title,
            'url': url,
            'heading': heading_text,
            'browser': 'chromium',
            'headless': True
        }

# Run the async function
result = asyncio.run(main())
print(json.dumps(result))
